purpose: Teach: 装丁/通信員/前倒し/相殺/概説/差し引い/値下がり/後ろ向き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社史の装丁を上質にしろ
lines.en: Make sure the company history is bound with quality materials.
lines.style: Direct, measured tone. Clipped consonants on key words. Expectant pause after the statement—this is an instruction, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外通信員からの報告を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've organized the reports from our overseas correspondents.
lines.style: Respectful efficiency. Clipped affirmative. Even delivery—competent, unburdening the boss of details. No apology in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、納期を前倒しできるか検討しろ
lines.en: Look into whether we can move up the deadline.
lines.style: Measured authority. Slight emphasis on 「前倒し」equivalent—accelerating. Not a suggestion. Short, commanding syntax.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様との損益を相殺で処理いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll offset the profit and loss figures with our preferred clients.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Slightly faster pace—showing competence. Precision in delivery. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プレゼンの冒頭で当社概説を入れろ
lines.en: Put a company overview at the start of the presentation.
lines.style: Crisp instruction. Weight on the opening—it matters. Brief. Exacting tone, as though expecting it was already obvious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。原価を差し引いた利益を計算しました
lines.en: Yes. I've calculated the profit after deducting costs.
lines.style: Brief, assured. Professional momentum. Shows the work is done. Steady eye contact in the voice—nothing left unsaid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、株式値下がりに備えろ
lines.en: Prepare the company for a potential stock decline.
lines.style: Measured, foresighted. No alarm—this is practical risk management. Steady tone. Weight on 「備える」—concrete preparation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。後ろ向きな見通しを社員に伝えないよう注意します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure not to convey pessimistic projections to the staff.
lines.style: Respectful assurance. Slight emphasis on the caution—understanding the responsibility. Professional finality. This is the last thing said.
